hero.title: Products, Orders, and Payments. All Connected.
hero.description: Services, physical goods, packages, and subscriptions — all with variant-level inventory, automated pricing, and Stripe checkout built in.

body: Four product types in one system: services, physical goods, packages, and subscriptions — all with variant-level stock tracking, low-stock alerts, and automatic deductions. Turn any product into a bookable appointment with configurable duration, capacity, hours, and business days. Embed a shopping cart or booking calendar directly into your website — no separate platform needed. Server-side line item calculation prevents client-side fraud across all channels.
catalogCaption: One catalog system handles all four. Turn any product into a bookable appointment or a website widget.
orderCaption: Orders auto-generate from bookings, website purchases, or manual creation. Line items calculated server-side — no client-side fraud.

benefits.title: Stock never lies
benefits.desc: Variant-level inventory deducts on order confirmation. Low-stock alerts fire automatically. Refunds restore stock.

benefits.title: Stripe in 3 clicks
benefits.desc: Checkout sessions, invoices, payment links, and refunds — all through Stripe Connect. Money goes to your bank, not a middleman.

benefits.title: Website → order → CRM
benefits.desc: Customer buys on your HABOS website. Order created. CRM contact upserted. Receipt sent. Zero manual data entry.

cta.heading: Other commerce tools are a separate platform. HABOS commerce is built into everything.
